response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), inv2 AS (SELECT * FROM inv WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM inv2) SELECT AVG(inv2.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(inv2.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(inv2.ratio - o.overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM inv2 CROSS JOIN o WHERE inv2.ratio > o.overall;

assumptions.assumption: An invoice's ratio is the average over its line items of derived_total_cost / product_price (line-level ratios, with null or zero-price lines ignored). The overall average ratio is the unweighted mean of the per-invoice ratios, and invoices with no computable ratio are excluded.
product_price is the 'unit price' referred to in the request.
The average product cost of the selected invoices is the mean of the per-invoice average derived_product_cost values (each invoice weighted equally).

alternatives.interpretation: An invoice's ratio is the average total cost divided by the average price, computed on lines where both values are non-null, instead of the average of line-level ratios.
alternatives.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(product_price), 0) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND product_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number), inv2 AS (SELECT * FROM inv WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM inv2) SELECT AVG(inv2.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(inv2.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(inv2.ratio - o.overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM inv2 CROSS JOIN o WHERE inv2.ratio > o.overall;
